name: yanlings_harbinger_finds_mu_yanling_in_graveyard_no_shuffle
notes: Pf8fa4a9835 G4. Printed: '... search your library and/or graveyard ... If you search your library this way, shuffle.' The Harbinger enters, accepts the may and searches the graveyard only (option 2): Mu Yanling, Celestial Wind goes from the graveyard to hand, and the unsearched library keeps its exact order (no shuffle).
